protocol: RTX5090 32GB, Windows,128GB RAM; context512/batch8, F32 KV, FA on, greedy, TF32/graphs/reuse off. Same prompt24, four fresh-KV requests of32 tokens (31 decode forwards). First request excluded from warm summaries. Logits export on, CUDA trace off.
selection: Reader1 was faster and used less aggregate CPU time than reader2 at chunk8. Chunks4/16 passed fixture correctness, but were not ranked for full-model performance. This is the best measured configuration here, not a global optimum.
limitations: OS file cache was not flushed; cold means first request in a new process, not a cold SSD.
One repeated prompt, three warm repetitions, sync/pipeline1/pipeline2/sync order; not a P6 workload benchmark.
Other applications and paging affect absolute speed; global sampled memory includes others and can miss transients.
CPU core equivalents include load/lifecycle and sampling; they do not identify matrix compute. GPU-only audit rejects non-GPU graph compute.
Identical graph/quants transport parity; no independent full-model Transformers oracle. Physical SSD I/O unmeasured.
Small measured CUDA interval overlap does not establish substantial kernel/H2D overlap; trace is in model/diagnostic reports.
